strings.en:
New Century 187.
Six months have passed since the end of the DC War against
the Divine Crusaders, who rebelled against the Federation,
and the L5 Campaign against the alien Aerogators...

Having lost its core leadership and key figures
in the war, the Earth Federation Government was
forced to reorganize, and Bryan Midcrid, President
of the Colony Union, became President of the
Federation Government.

He then made the L5 Campaign records public
before the Federation Congress...
This announcement, later called the
"Tokyo Declaration," officially acknowledged
the existence of extraterrestrial intelligence
and suggested it posed a threat to humanity.

President Midcrid also called for the Earth Sphere to unite,
and announced the "Aegis Plan," a program to restructure the
Federation Army and build up its arms. In the plan's name,
humanoid mobile weapons were mass-produced and upgraded.
Yet others lurked in the shadows.

Remnants of the military organization once led by
Dr. Bian Zoldark, the Divine Crusaders, or "DC"...
Those within the Federation Government and Army
who scheme to establish a military regime...
The "shadow" that connects them all...
And the mysterious entities known as
the "Einst Series"...
Humanity was about to sink into deeper chaos...

A transport plane is headed for the Tesla Reich Institute. Aboard
are the Exxelant, equipped with a Time Flow Engine powered by
time particles, and its test pilots, the siblings Raul and Fiona.
But just short of the institute, a mysterious unit appears.
Axel Almer, pilot of the Soulgain, demands they hand over the
Exxelant...

Raul and the others disappear somewhere, along with an Unknown
that suddenly appeared. Axel rejoins the mysterious unit that has
seized the Tesla Reich Institute and is preparing for a transfer,
but...

The ATX Team, stationed at the Earth Federation Army's North
American Langley Base, is on a mission to hunt down DC remnants.
Joining Kyosuke and the others is Lamia Loveless, pilot of the
mysterious super robot Angelg.

At Hickam Base in Hawaii, the Tactical Instructor Unit's
prototype PT test comes under assault by DC remnants. One
of them, Seolla Schweizer, Latune's old friend from
The School, steals the ATX Project's new Bildfalken.

Pursuing the DC remnants, the Hagane heads to Shandong, China.
The remnants attack the LTR Organization's Dr. Anzai, who is
excavating Choukijin at the Chiyou Mound ruins: semi-organic
weapons the ancients built to fight the demons and monsters
known as the Hundred Evils. During the battle, an Unknown
appears via spatial transfer.

The DC remnants step up their activity from Earth Cradle,
and the Hagane begins pursuing them. Latune encounters
Arado Balanga, an old friend from The School, in an enemy
unit they've tracked down. Shot down while shielding Seolla,
Arado is taken prisoner.

Learning of Operation Kill Mole, the Federation's attack on
Earth Cradle, the DC remnants strike the Hagane to stall it.
As the fighting drags on, the Unknown appears again, and
Kyosuke hears the voice of a girl who calls herself Einst.

The DC remnants' Operation Desert Cross, a campaign to seize
northern Africa, causes the Federation's Operation Kill Mole
to fail. Van Vat Tran, leader of the DC remnants, declares
the birth of a new DC: the Neue DC.

Investigating the disappearance of Federation units, the
Hiryu Custom heads to L2 and encounters unidentified mobile
weapons. Taking the matter seriously, the Federation
government and military leadership issue Case E. Before
taking up defense of the White Star at L5, the Hiryu Custom
stops at Mao Industries HQ on the moon. A mysterious force
appears, but Arado's efforts get them out of the crisis
and drive the enemy back.

The Neue DC invades the Principality of Riksent to make it a
beachhead for an attack on Aviano Base, a major Federation
stronghold. Protecting the escaped Princess Shine, Rai comes
face to face with his nemesis, Archibald Grims.

The mysterious enemy that attacked and seized the White Star
is an alien race calling themselves the Inspectors. Using
spatial transfer tactics, they begin capturing Earth's key
military bases. At Mao Industries, under attack once again,
a transport carrying new PTs attempts to escape. To save his
cornered comrades, Ryoto activates the Huckebein Mk-III...

Ryoto's quick thinking gets them off the moon, but the
Inspectors seize Mao Industries and Moon Cradle. Meanwhile,
they also strike the Tesla Reich Institute, where Filio
Presty leads Project TD, an interstellar travel program. The
institute falls to the enemy along with its staff, including
director Jonathan.

Ibis's group escapes the institute with Project TD's
prototype. Stung that she wasn't chosen to pilot the
Alpha Proto, Sleigh leaves the group. Meanwhile, Seolla
appears before Arado, her memory altered by Dr. Aguila
Setome so that she sees him as an enemy.

To retake the Principality of Riksent, the Neue DC's
beachhead into southern Europe, the Hagane attacks the Neue
DC garrison while a Shirogane-led detachment creates a
diversion. Thanks in part to Latune and Shine's new AM, the
Fairlion, they retake Riksent, but Captain Lee Linjun's
misjudgment leads to the Shirogane's capture by the enemy.

Operation Plantagenet, the counteroffensive against the
Inspectors. En route to Izu Base to take part, the Hiryu
Custom finds Wodan blocking its path. Coming to the rescue
is Sänger, missing since the L5 Campaign. Meanwhile, Bullet
and the others head to Chiyou Mound to unravel the Einst
mystery. As Bullet and Kusuha struggle against the foes who
appear there, the Choukijin reveals itself...

Absorbing Kusuha and Bullet's power, along with the Grungust
Type 3, the Choukijin awakens as RyuKoOh. Meanwhile, Axel
appears before Kyosuke and calls the Alteisen "Gespenst
Mk-III." Kyosuke is bewildered by Axel targeting him.

At the Federation's Izu Base, Gryen Grassman's faction,
which calls for all-out war against the aliens, stages a
coup called "Mission Harper," and Commander Laker is
detained. Amid the chaos, Vindel Mauser's special task
force, Shadow Mirror, appears. And Lamia's secret mission
and true identity come to light...

Lamia is an artificial human of the "W Series," developed by
Lemon Browning. Meanwhile, Mai, who had lost her memories,
learns she was once the Aerogators' leader, Levi Torah. In
battle, Mai and Aya are told the truth of their birth. Though
shaken, they accept their past, and their bond grows deeper.

Recovered by Lemon, Lamia resolves to break with Shadow
Mirror. Lamia and Gilliam reveal that Shadow Mirror came
here after its defeat by the Beowulves, a Federation
special suppression unit on a parallel Earth, and that
Gilliam is also a traveler, whose presence as the core of
System XN is needed to ensure a reliable dimensional jump.

Sänger's team moves to retake the Inspector-held Tesla Reich
Institute, but Vigagi blocks their way. The cornered Sänger is
saved by a masked man: Wodan. Filio's group barely manages
to activate Double G Unit 1, a humanoid mobile weapon
hidden beneath the institute, but...

With the institute retaken, Ibis's group is reunited with Filio.
As Operation Plantagenet nears its end, the Hagane and Hiryu
Custom join forces with Van Ba Chun's Neue DC unit to raid
Langley Base. But a surprise attack by Shadow Mirror, now allied
with the Inspectors, leaves the Hagane heavily damaged...

Using the chaos of the Einst's appearance, the group barely
escapes, but Kyosuke is gravely wounded, and Captain Daitetsu
loses his life.

Summoned by a mysterious voice, Excellen leaves the ship and
disappears. Pursuing her, Arado's group encounters Seolla.
In battle against the Machinery Children created by Dr. Egret
Fehu, Seolla regains her memories and resolves to fight
alongside Arado and the others.

A runaway Time Flow Engine sends Raul's group from "over there"
to "over here," where Axel, Fiona's sworn enemy, appears.
Rescued from danger by Gilliam and Lamia, Raul's group joins
forces with Gilliam.

The Einst begin indiscriminate attacks on every faction's bases.
Amid the chaos, the operation to take Earth Cradle begins.
Sänger faces Wodan, defender of the Gate of Magus. The Kurogane
storms Earth Cradle, where Rätsel and Rai finally defeat their
nemesis Archibald. Meanwhile, Latune's desperate pleas help
Ouka regain her memories, but...

Entrusted with Wodan's hopes, Sänger destroys Magus, which
controls the Machine Cells, self-repairing, self-evolving metal
cells made by Dr. Egret Fehu, and rescues Dr. Sophia Nate,
who had been used as its core.

The Hiryu Custom heads for Moon Cradle, the Inspectors'
production base, but a transformed Excellen blocks its path.
Kyosuke sorties in his new Alteisen Riese, but his voice doesn't
reach her, and Excellen departs. With Shu's help, the joint
operation by the Neue DC and Hiryu Custom to retake Moon Cradle
ends in success.

The Kurogane and Hiryu Custom unite to attack the White Star,
but Excellen appears before them once again. In the crisis,
Kyosuke's all-or-nothing appeal brings her back to her senses.

As the Einst attacks continue, the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom
launch a surprise raid on the White Star. When Kyosuke strikes,
Echidna chooses to take the blow in Axel's place.

The Kurogane and Hiryu Custom storm the White Star's interior.
After a fierce battle, Kyosuke defeats Axel. Then Wendolo,
supreme commander of the Inspectors, reveals himself. Having
audited Earth's civilization, the Inspectors have judged that
humanity's insatiable Resolve will one day disrupt galactic
order, and so seek to bring the Earth Sphere under their rule.

Kyosuke and the others manage to defeat Wendolo, but an energy
field deployed by the Einst traps the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom
inside the White Star. Shadow Mirror attempts to capture
Gilliam in order to perform a dimensional transfer. The group
defeats Vindel, but...

System XN connects the Einst's realm with our world, and the
erosion of Space begins. Having watched intelligent life since
ancient times, the Einst seek to annihilate humanity, which
endlessly wars with itself and disturbs the calm of Space, and
to create new intelligent life. Their leader, Neu Regisseur,
merges with the White Star and transforms into the colossal
mobile weapon Stern Neu Regisseur. The final battle begins.

After Stern Neu Regisseur's destruction, the Einst Series units
active around the world also cease functioning and vanish.
The fighting is over, and a time of peace comes to the world.
